title: Pitch tactics (3D)
description: A tilted football pitch with regulation markings, two teams' numbered tokens moving along paths, pass arrows that draw on the grass with the ball following, dashed runs and a pulsing pressing zone. Generic colours only, no crests.

title.description: Headline; wrap one word in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

home.description: {name, color} of the team attacking the far goal. Generic colours; no club crests or marks.

players.description: Tokens {id, team: home|away, n (shirt number), from: [x, z], to: [x, z], move: [start s, duration s]}. Metres: x -34..34 across, z 52.5 (near goal line) .. -52.5 (far goal line).

passes.description: Pass arrows {from: id, to: id or [x, z], at, dur, bend (metres, curve sideways), loft (metres, ball height)}. The ball follows each pass and stays with the receiver.

runs.description: Dashed run arrows {player, at} drawn along that player's from -> to path.

press.description: Pressing zone {points: [[x, z], ...] (convex), at, label}. Omit or set to null for none.

notes.description: Extra HTML notes {text, at: [x, z], time}.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: no club crests, kits or sponsor marks
tokens do not overlap at rest
arrows start and end at token edges
